title: The United Molecules Network Database — Network Overview (Signature edition)
description: Signature edition of the public record, organized in the Signature system. The United Molecules Network ties all 60 molecule databases into one deterministic system: every molecule's data scales from its parsed formula — composition, molar mass, particle counts, isotopic variants — up through reactions and materials to bulk applications. Six category records map the network; the member catalog lists every molecule database.
how_it_works: The network is the database of databases: each member is a full database, and this network database is the map, the cross-reference, and the scaling law that ties them together.

title: The United Molecules Network Database — Determinism Spec
description: Determinism contract for the The United Molecules Network Database: every record in every member database derives reproducibly from base data — atomic numbers and CIAAW 2021 atomic weights for matter; quark quantum numbers for quarks. Same inputs, same records, every build. No invented values anywhere in the chain.
how_it_works: The spec is enforced at build: formula parsing, mass derivation, isotopic variants, and hadron composition are all computed, then re-derived independently in the embedded JavaScript demos, which fail the build on any mismatch.
key_points: Base data: atomic weights / quark quantum numbers
